requirements.requirement: Coherent stipulated C0 meanings, hypothetical rules and opaque names in explicitly paid nominal frames are allowed. Independent lexical/semantic proof is not a prerequisite for internal derivability. Audit under the actual declared dictionary; lack of external meaning confirmation is a claim ceiling, not an automatic derivation failure. Distinguish a merely hypothetical interpretation from underdefined, missing or type-inconsistent flow.

Freeze one finite dictionary, signatures, productions, type schemas, overload/default/attachment/scope priorities, stage policy and input-substitution rule before application bodies open. Repeated exact wholes use the same function or explicitly finite contextual overload with frozen selection guards. Fresh instances may differ under the same allocator. No occurrence-specific or desired-answer dictionary switch. A fixed parametric opaque-name binder in a nominal frame may introduce literal names without adding biological glosses; disclose its charge, type, accepted raw class and per-name identity ledger.

Preserve every source ID, native reader, raw whole/line/separator/entity/uncertainty field, flags, within-unit order and supplied annotation across all readers. Exact cached GDT1051/GDT012/GDT062/GDT605 applications remain unchanged; retain their different cuts, whole/context residuals and rejects. These formal applications do not identify morphemes. No new parser/training, prefix deletion, transcription repair, allomorph merge or universal morph tree. A new semantic split is an explicit C0 rule/cost, not a new established parse.

Declare Kind, Spec and Instance separately; Plan, Call, Execution/Event and Output/Result separately; also nominal description, predicate, assertion, instruction, goal and achieved outcome. A MaterialSpec is not a ProcessPlan, a goal does not execute itself and an asserted historical result is not observed efficacy. All allocation, type lift, attached-protocol bridge, assertion conversion and mode changes must be explicit and priced.

Produce the earlier ProcessPlan from actual earlier source-linked operation steps, formal input slots, ordering and closure. Retain its exact plan ID, producing source IDs, captured constants, formal slots/types, ordered instruction sequence, substeps and result schema. An initially donated Plan or an entry-name-to-whole-protocol card does not demonstrate written plan production. A priced capture rule may store a plan from the earlier instruction stream; record whether earlier steps define, execute, or both, avoiding uncounted duplicate actions.

Freeze one global rule resolving whole-plan versus stage/subplan scope, earlier-plan reference and any allowed stage labels/selectors. It may use declared written boundaries/types and deterministic priorities, never a different hand-picked favorable subset for each application. Preserve exact candidate stages, selected stage identity and any ambiguity. No after-result fire stage, convenient clause, previous leaf or additional earlier paragraph. A written stage scope or paid global scope convention is acceptable C0, provided its application is consistent and complete.

A call must obtain the current input from a written producer/expression in the current unit and substitute it only into the frozen formal slots. Keep captured constants unchanged; do not copy all earlier ingredients, substitute an earlier result for the current input, or let the desired output choose a referent. Record input kind/spec/instance and any priced preparation/allocation required by slot typing. Initial-context participants/defaults are allowed as paid premises but cannot count as written production of the nominated current input.

Invocation preserves the selected plan operation order and generates fresh execution/event/result IDs, with source provenance to the written call and earlier plan. Give full bindings and before/after states for each expanded operation/substep. Do not relabel an old result as fresh, replay an observation without declaring its identity rule, introduce a hidden extra execution, or hide a reset/allocation inside a checkpoint. If output is a described/claimed result rather than an executed physical change, type and report it accordingly.

At least one later actual written consumer must consume the call-generated output/event or an explicitly derived reference to it. Supply every claimed consumer source ID, typed input, operation, output and full producer-to-consumer path. If two are claimed, show both distinct typed uses. Equality with an ambient initial object is not provenance. An internally defined flow can satisfy this C0 dependency criterion without proving true manuscript semantics; a paid attached-protocol rival may preserve its consequence and leave meanings unresolved.

Annotate every conserved raw group, including unknown/blocked groups. Give exact entry/rule/parts, argument IDs/types, preconditions, scope/mode, registers before/delta/after, plan/call/event/result IDs, and pending opening/discharge. Report actual first barrier per paragraph/reader and its dependency consequence. Unknown or marked possible control words cannot silently become opaque nouns, nulls or ignorable fillers. A nominal classification or neutral contribution is allowed only through an explicit paid frozen rule whose premises hold; unresolved ambiguity blocks dependent claims. Later known steps do not restart the failed flow without a separately declared legitimate independent scope.

Charge every new whole/part value, changed inherited hypothesis, production, macro substep, default, overload, exception, type lift, bridge, initial binding, scope/reset/import/closure convention and stage-selection policy. Distinguish dictionary meanings from parametric opaque nominal names, and list name-instantiation costs or the frozen rule charging them. Derived wholes require only already paid parts/rules unless a residual adds new content. A shorter lexical list is not automatically compression when macros/rules carry the missing information.

Discovery is exactly f83r.1–8 plus9–17 and f83v.11–20 plus21–33. Applications are exactly f75v.38–42 plus43–49 and f104v.19–21 plus22–26. All eight paragraphs/windows and all three readers remain separate coverage cells. RF literal0/0 flags are unavailable native boundaries; matching-locus windows remain external. Application bodies stay closed until FW and independent FV candidates/predictions freeze or an author freezes non-capacity. FW larger scope cannot repair frozen FV or donate a previously unregistered FV role.

Separate source conservation, repeat/price consistency, complete or partial manual C0 derivation, any materialized execution replay, written dependency success, NO_CAPACITY and contradiction of the fixed model. A scripted row/annotation check is not a full grammar/parser PASS. Author-specific typed conflict rejects that stipulated model, not all possible meanings. Opaque nominal role coverage is not named-material translation. Prior project exposure and zero independent confirmation capacity remain disclosed. GDT947/1047 and all prior fixed failures remain unchanged.

Before opening applications freeze complete candidate dictionary/grammar/typed discovery derivation, interpretation of criteria, per-application Plan/input/stage/consumer requirements and absent-pair alternative treatment. Report literal application under that model with the first real gap or failure. Missing exact pair is unbound for the nominated operator, not automatic contradiction or repaired spelling alias. Pure relabeling or a priced rival preserving full/projection consequences leaves meaning unresolved; no new model revision after seeing transfer bodies counts as frozen success.

minimal_flow: Written earlier operation sequence + formal slots + closure -> ProcessPlan P
Frozen global whole/stage policy + written call reference -> SelectedPlanOrStage S(P)
Written current input -> typed input x, via any priced allocation/preparation
Invoke(S,x,captured_constants) -> fresh Execution E and Output y
Later written consumer(y or derived_ref(y), ...) -> actual stated typed consequence

statuses.COMPLETE_MANUAL_C0_DERIVATION: Every finite written stage under stipulated dictionary/rules follows declared typed premises; no independent semantics required.
statuses.PARTIAL_OR_UNDERDEFINED_C0_DERIVATION: Actual missing/underdefined stage recorded; dependent claims blocked.
statuses.WRITTEN_PLAN_CALL_CONSUMER_FLOW_C0: Actual earlier written Plan, current written input, fresh invocation output and later consumer path all supplied consistently.
statuses.NO_CAPACITY: Missing steps/input/consumer/type/boundary or unresolved scope ambiguity prevents check.
statuses.FIXED_MODEL_CONTRADICTION: Available explicit input violates frozen rule/type/arity/reference constraint.
statuses.UNBOUND_EXACT_OPERATOR: Missing pair reader retains all raw groups but no nominated operator binding.
statuses.MATERIALIZED_EXECUTION_REPLAY: Only if transition implementation exists and actual states are independently replayed. No new engine required.
statuses.ROLE_COVERAGE_ONLY: Opaque nominal identities/frame roles accounted; material-name meanings unconfirmed.
statuses.FULL_GRAMMAR_OR_CONFIRMED_MEANING: Not established by these internal manual/bookkeeping checks.
